remarks: Build the home of your dreams with the popular Wakefield ranch by Natale Builders! This thoughtfully designed floor plan offers 1,648 sq. ft. of modern, single-level living with 2–3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and a 2-car garage. Step into a bright and welcoming foyer that opens to an expansive, airy layout. Just off the entry are two versatile rooms—perfect for guest bedrooms, a home office, or hobby spaces. The rear of the home showcases an impressive great room, a spacious dinette, and a stunning designer kitchen featuring a large island ideal for cooking, gathering, and entertaining. Conveniently located off the dinette, the mudroom and laundry room offer easy access to the luxurious primary suite. The primary suite includes a generous walk-in closet and a private ensuite bath with double sinks. Work with Natale’s professional design team to personalize every detail and create a home that perfectly fits your lifestyle. This is a TO-BE-BUILT home on vacant land—start designing your brand new home today!
